CP-01 / A second file

One credit file sets the cap on your funding until a second file joins your plan.

One partner file is already part of the Capital Blueprint, and it goes to work before your own file is ready.

  • The Blueprint lets one spouse or business partner join your file as a second applicant.
  • Their amount adds to yours, so your total grows past what your own file reaches by itself.
  • Your own credit file sets the CAP on your funding. One partner file is part of the Blueprint, and it goes to work before your file is ready.
  • The reason is simple. Every amount on your plan comes off one person's report, so with only your file in it, your total ends where your file ends.
  • Every dollar your own file can't reach yet is a dollar your business goes without, whether that's the next hire, a bigger job, or more ads.
  • When your own report keeps your funding low, the move is to bring in a spouse or business partner with GOOD credit while your file gets its work done.
  • It's right there in the offer. The Fundhub team adds one spouse or business partner to your file as a second applicant, and that partner file is included.
  • Their amount adds to yours on the same plan, so your total climbs past the point where your own file stops, and it keeps adding after your file is ready.

CP-02 / Their file

Your partner's file runs on its own track, with its own signature and its own checklist.

  • Nothing gets read on your partner until they sign their own soft pull form.
  • Their checklist comes from their own report, so every step on it fits their file.
  • You work your steps and they work theirs, so both files move at the same time.
  • Here's how the Blueprint handles it. Your partner's file runs on its OWN track, right next to yours, with its own report and its own steps.
  • Nothing gets read on your partner until THEY sign. They sign the same soft pull form you sign, and their signature is what opens their file.
  • That form spells it out. The soft pull doesn't lower their score, and lenders don't see it as an application, so their file stays exactly where it was.
  • Your partner stays in control of their permission. The form says they withdraw it in writing whenever they choose, and it covers one pull only.
  • Once they sign, the Blueprint builds their checklist from their own report, so every card and every item on their list belongs to their file.
  • Look at the two files side by side. Each one shows a signed form at the top and its own steps underneath, and both sit under one Capital Blueprint.
  • For you, that means both files move at the same TIME. You work your steps, and your partner works theirs, on the same plan.

CP-03 / The math

Your total is your amount plus your partner's amount, each one figured from its own file.

  • Each amount comes off that person's own report, the way it stands today.
  • Your plan adds the two together and shows one total.
  • A bigger total puts more capital behind your next hire, your next big job and your ads.
  • Here's the MATH, and it's simple. Your total is your amount plus your partner's amount, and each of those comes from its own file.
  • Each amount is how much that one person qualifies for, read off their own report the way it stands today. Your report counts for you, and theirs counts for them.
  • Then your plan adds the two together and shows ONE total. That total is what the two of you are working toward, step by step.
  • Now think about what that bigger total does for your BUSINESS. It's the next hire, the bigger jobs you can say yes to, and ads that keep running.
  • And your business grows on capital from two files, while your own savings stay right where they are, ready for whatever comes up next.
  • Look at the picture: your amount, plus your partner's amount, equals your total. The boxes stay blank here, because your real amounts come off your two real files.
  • And when the files are ready, you take that total to the banks yourself. Each bank makes its own decision on each application.

CP-04 / My circle

I fund my own deals with a circle of partners, and your credit partner starts yours.

  • My funding circle is an inner group of partners who help fund my deals, and I still fund myself too.
  • Four of my companies each got a $100,000 credit line off my one personal file, on stated income.
  • Every partner you add puts another file behind your deals, starting with your credit partner.
  • Here's how I do it MYSELF. Everyone should build a funding circle, and I build mine all the time. It's how I fund my own deals.
  • My funding circle is my inner group of partners, and every one of them helps fund my deals. I still fund myself on top of that.
  • Here's what funding myself looks like. Four of my companies each got a $100,000 credit line, all off ONE personal file, and the banks never asked me for an income document.
  • I've done this for ten years. The capital I raise goes into cash-flowing companies, and I've lost money on some of them along the way.
  • On the Blueprint, the FIRST person in your circle is your credit partner, and that one included file is where your circle starts.
  • In the picture, you sit in the middle. Each person around you is a partner, and each one puts their own file behind your deals.
  • That's what a circle gets your business: more files behind every deal you take on, so your growth stands on more than one credit file.

CP-05 / Your call

Your partner is welcome on your strategy call, where you both see your real file.

  • If you make money decisions with someone, they hear the plan at the same moment you do.
  • A soft pull reads your file on the call, and you both see how much you qualify for based on where you're at right now.
  • After you join, your partner signs their own form, and both files go to work at the same time.
  • Remember that partner file that goes to work before yours is ready? It starts once you join the Blueprint and your partner signs their own form.
  • And that person is welcome on your strategy CALL. If you make money decisions with someone, they hear the plan at the same moment you do.
  • On the call, a soft pull reads your file while you're both sitting there. It leaves your score alone, and the banks never see it on your report.
  • Then you both see how much you qualify for based on where you're at right now, and which step on your file comes FIRST.
  • The Fundhub team and an AI coach stay with you through every step on the Blueprint, so you always know the next move on your file.
  • When your files are ready, you fund yourselves. With two files behind it, your business takes on the jobs, the hires and the ad spend that one file held back.
